map.：FAB 形态学分型：AML 依骨髓原始细胞比例与分化（M0 微分化、M1 未成: : FAB morphological typing: AML by bone marrow blast proportion and differentiation (M0 minimally differentiated, M1 without maturation, M2 granulocytic, M3 promyelocytic (APL), M4 myelomonocytic, M5 monocytic, M6 erythroleukemia, M7 megakaryoblastic); ALL divided into L1 (small and uniform), L2 (large and variable), L3 (Burkitt-like). Modern diagnosis uses MICM: immunophenotyping sets lineage, chromosomes/fusion genes (such as PML-RARA, AML1-ETO) set prognosis and targets.
map.：例（AML：骨髓原始粒细胞 45%、Auer 小体阳性、t(15;17) 阳性: : example (AML: bone marrow myeloblasts 45%, Auer rods positive, t(15;17) positive): FAB classifies as M3 (acute promyelocytic leukaemia APL), immune/molecular confirmation of PML-RARA fusion -> high risk but curable, all-trans retinoic acid (ATRA) plus arsenic is first choice, and differentiation syndrome induced by chemotherapy alone is contraindicated.
map.FAB 仍是形态学沟通基础，但 WHO/ICC 现行分类更强调遗传学（如伴 RU: FAB is still the morphological communication baseline, but current WHO/ICC classifications emphasize genetics (such as RUNX1::RUNX1T1, PML-RARA) and molecular markers; morphology alone misclassifies easily, so MICM must be combined.
map.M3/APL 因 t(15;17) 致 PML-RARA，对 ATRA+砷剂高度: M3/APL is driven by t(15;17) producing PML-RARA; it is highly sensitive to and curable by ATRA plus arsenic, but differentiation syndrome and bleeding (DIC) occur easily during induction, so management differs from other AML and early recognition is essential.
